title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

reports.title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

summary:
A former Costa Mesa police officer pleaded guilty to contacting his mistress thousands of times through text messages, phone calls, and social media. On at least one day, he reached out more than 100 times. He also admitted to illegally using confidential law enforcement databases to look up information about his wife, an ex-girlfriend, and men he considered romantic rivals.

The plea was entered in court, but the article does not state what sentence he will receive or when sentencing will occur. The case involves both obsessive personal communication and misuse of official police records. No further details about the next legal step were provided.
